summary: Implemented and executed a durable four-surface registry candidate with stable surface IDs, accent-insensitive aliases, root/owner/context/Page Change Thread/local planner/local steward pointers, privacy/authority labels and fail-closed public-route semantics. Current project/catalog evidence does not yet bind an exact canonical public route for any of the four swarm surfaces, so all four remain explicitly UNRESOLVED with null URL/page_id and exact truth-recovery opportunity pointers instead of guessed routes.

preserve_first_evidence: Reused PROJECT_INDEX project/chat-object/workstream bindings instead of inventing a second project registry.
Referenced existing Page Change Thread execution protocol and O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1 rather than creating a second messaging system.
Referenced existing local planner and dependency-gated local integration opportunity IDs from Q-UNIVERSAL-COGNITIVE-SWARM-01.
Catalog Study/student pages are retained only as related evidence; name similarity never upgrades them into canonical surface routes.
negative_knowledge: A page present in Catalog is not automatically the canonical route for a similarly named swarm surface.
Facultad currently remains REGISTERED_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED with no bound primary Chat Object/workstream in PROJECT_INDEX.
Alumnos has known child workstreams but no primary Chat Object binding in PROJECT_INDEX.
This candidate registry has no promotion authority and does not replace Current, Catalog, Lineage, project ownership or Served verification.
remaining_boundary: Exact public route bindings remain intentionally unresolved until the corresponding O-SURFACE-*-TRUTH-V1 returns or another authoritative exact binding proves them. This is expected evidence-gated incompleteness, not a registry failure.
deduplication_reason: Route archaeology, Page Change Thread bridge, local planners and local integration are already represented by active/prepared opportunities; emitting duplicates would reduce swarm throughput.
